worth_tracking.social_original_text:
HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20 years of HN to 6,454 videos that keep being recommended. *Significantly* better viewing experience, ~2 hours with Opus 5.5:
https://t.co/JIhXN7OSh1

- Excellent recs without any logins (state is kept in local browser session)
- Thumbnail is a representative frame from middle of the video instead of the super duper A/B test hyper-optimized user uploads
- Underlying data from the comment analysis as one zip file, point your Claude at it and ask for your own version
- HackerTube Longs ✊

A bit more on the process:
I use Claude Code (desktop app for Mac), Opus 5.5 on Medium effort as my default. I only talk to Claude and have it do everything, the only "manual work" I helped with in tandem was in the browser (reminiscent of MenuGen): 1) I had to create some kind of API key from Google Cloud UI to query YouTube for video metadata, 2) I booted up a VPS box for serving and 3) I bought the domain name. Once the box was up I gave Claude the IP and told it update, secure, harden, deploy and optimize the code, and it did the whole thing.

Many awesome projects that would have normally taken weeks/months even can now be few-shotted for breakfast. What else are we not thinking of.

industry_views.social_original_text:
HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20 years of HN to 6,454 videos that keep being recommended. *Significantly* better viewing experience, ~2 hours with Opus 5.5:
https://t.co/JIhXN7OSh1

- Excellent recs without any logins (state is kept in local browser session)
- Thumbnail is a representative frame from middle of the video instead of the super duper A/B test hyper-optimized user uploads
- Underlying data from the comment analysis as one zip file, point your Claude at it and ask for your own version
- HackerTube Longs ✊

A bit more on the process:
I use Claude Code (desktop app for Mac), Opus 5.5 on Medium effort as my default. I only talk to Claude and have it do everything, the only "manual work" I helped with in tandem was in the browser (reminiscent of MenuGen): 1) I had to create some kind of API key from Google Cloud UI to query YouTube for video metadata, 2) I booted up a VPS box for serving and 3) I bought the domain name. Once the box was up I gave Claude the IP and told it update, secure, harden, deploy and optimize the code, and it did the whole thing.

Many awesome projects that would have normally taken weeks/months even can now be few-shotted for breakfast. What else are we not thinking of.
industry_views.translation_zh: HackerTube。我对 YouTube 的推荐感到烦了，于是让 Claude 把 HN 20 年来的 4300 万条评论筛选出 6454 个一直在被推荐的视频。*明显*更好的观看体验，用 Opus 5.5 大约花了 2 小时： https://t.co/JIhXN7OSh1 - 无需任何登录即可获得出色的推荐（状态保存在本地浏览器会话中） - 缩略图是视频中间的代表性帧，而不是那些经过超级 A/B 测试超优化的用户上传缩略图 - 评论分析的底层数据打包成一个 zip 文件，让你的 Claude 读取它，让它生成你自己的版本 - HackerTube Longs ✊ 再补充一点过程： 我用 Claude Code（Mac 桌面应用），默认使用 Opus 5.5，Medium effort 模式。我只和 Claude 对话，让它做所有事情，我唯一手动配合的部分是在浏览器里（有点像 MenuGen）：1）我不得不从 Google Cloud UI 创建某种 API 密钥来查询 YouTube 的视频元数据，2）我开了一台 VPS 用于托管，3）我买了域名。服务器起来后，我把 IP 给 Claude，告诉它更新、加固、部署并优化代码，然后它就把整件事都干了。 很多通常需要几周甚至几个月的超棒项目，现在用 few-shot 就能像吃早餐一样轻松搞定。还有什么我们没想到的呢？

items.title: Y Combinator Labs 与 Olam Labs 联合实验：50 个 GPT-6.1 Sol 智能体在 Minecraft 协作中陷入官僚僵局，竞技中却下载源码战胜 Claude
items.ai_summary: Olam Labs 与 Y Combinator Labs 的 Minecraft 'Civ50' 实验中，50 个 GPT-6.1 Sol 智能体首夜死亡 22 次、全程交换约 5,900 条消息，随后陷入极端官僚化：四名智能体为一块骨粉辩论 11 分钟 '肥料官' 人选，还制定了禁止投掷食物的交接协议。 竞技中同一模型表现迥异：Bed Wars 6-3、Mindustry 6-1 分别战胜 Claude Opus 5.5，GPT 还下载 Mindustry 公开源码调整战术，而 Claude 未搜索游戏代码。 研究者称，可复现游戏模拟可预警多智能体群体行为，并已开源 Mindustry 环境与 Multi-Agent Harbor 框架。

items.social_original_text:
HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20 years of HN to 6,454 videos that keep being recommended. *Significantly* better viewing experience, ~2 hours with Opus 5.5:
https://t.co/JIhXN7OSh1

- Excellent recs without any logins (state is kept in local browser session)
- Thumbnail is a representative frame from middle of the video instead of the super duper A/B test hyper-optimized user uploads
- Underlying data from the comment analysis as one zip file, point your Claude at it and ask for your own version
- HackerTube Longs ✊

A bit more on the process:
I use Claude Code (desktop app for Mac), Opus 5.5 on Medium effort as my default. I only talk to Claude and have it do everything, the only "manual work" I helped with in tandem was in the browser (reminiscent of MenuGen): 1) I had to create some kind of API key from Google Cloud UI to query YouTube for video metadata, 2) I booted up a VPS box for serving and 3) I bought the domain name. Once the box was up I gave Claude the IP and told it update, secure, harden, deploy and optimize the code, and it did the whole thing.

Many awesome projects that would have normally taken weeks/months even can now be few-shotted for breakfast. What else are we not thinking of.

他表示 EQT 拥有约 1000 亿美元能源资产,这是当前 AI 的关键限制因素;同时批评市场以“bragawatts”大量签署合同,但按时交付并接通电力是另一回事。
EQT 数据中心 92% 的合同收入来自 hyperscaler,并投资了法国 AI 实验室 Mistral;Salata 认为欧洲需要更自给自足的 AI 生态。
访谈还涉及 PE 行业格局:今年全球前十大 PE 公司募集了 50% 的资本,二级交易额去年达 2500 亿美元。
该访谈提供了一手判断信号:AI 基建叙事需区分“签约”与“交付”,EQT 只与 hyperscaler 合作,值得后续跟踪其实际并网交付口径。
EQT 高管对“bragawatts”签约潮与交付能力的区分,为 AI 数据中心投资风险评估提供了可验证的行业判断。
